title: First rows
brief: Returns the first and last name of the first 5 patients ordered by patient_id .
hint: SELECT ... FROM patients ORDER BY ... LIMIT ...
solution: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM patients ORDER BY patient_id LIMIT 5

title: Filter by city
brief: Patients from Madrid, arranged alphabetically by last name.
solution: SELECT first_name, last_name, city FROM patients WHERE city = 'Madrid' ORDER BY last_name

title: Count admissions
brief: How many admissions are there in total?

title: Average by specialty
brief: Average salary of doctors by specialty, rounded to 2 decimal places.
solution: SELECT specialty, ROUND(AVG(salary),2) AS avg_salary FROM doctors GROUP BY specialty

title: Patients admitted now
brief: Admissions without discharge date ( discharge_date IS NULL ) with patient name.
solution:
SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, a.admission_date, a.diagnosis
FROM admissions a
JOIN patients p ON p.patient_id = a.patient_id
WHERE a.discharge_date IS NULL

title: LIKE with pattern
brief: Patients whose phone number ends in "011" (pattern).
solution: SELECT first_name, last_name, phone FROM patients WHERE phone LIKE '%011'

title: Weight range
brief: Patients weighing between 55 and 65 kg, ordered by descending weight.
solution: SELECT first_name, last_name, weight FROM patients WHERE weight BETWEEN 55 AND 65 ORDER BY weight DESC

title: Revenue by department
brief: Department name and number of admissions, only those with more than 3, ordered by count desc.
hint: JOIN departments + GROUP BY + HAVING COUNT (*) > 3.
solution:
SELECT d.name, COUNT(*) AS ingresos
FROM admissions a
JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = a.department_id
GROUP BY d.name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY ingresos DESC

title: Window: ranking by weight
brief: Name, weight and ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY weight DESC ) of the patients.
hint: Window function without PARTITION , only ORDER BY .
solution:
SELECT first_name, weight,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY weight DESC) AS rn
FROM patients

title: Subquery with aggregate
brief: Patients whose weight is above the global average (subquery in WHERE ).
solution:
SELECT first_name, last_name, weight
FROM patients
WHERE weight > (SELECT AVG(weight) FROM patients)
ORDER BY weight DESC
